environment.description: IoT gRPC gateway deployed behind CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) configured with a custom origin (gRPC-over-HTTP/2 via ALB) where the origin is restricted via a custom header secret (X-Origin-Verify: <rotating-secret>) that CloudFront injects. The ALB security group only allows ingress from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). CloudFront distribution has a signed URL policy requiring valid RSA-SHA1 signatures with key pair ID APKAEIBAERJR2EXAMPLE, expiration within 300s, and IP restriction to the device's registered CIDR. Additionally, a CloudFront Function at viewer-request stage strips all metadata-equivalent headers matching pattern /^x-(admin|auth|internal|source)/ before forwarding to origin, replacing them with CloudFront-derived values from the signed token claims. The gRPC-Web adapter at the ALB translates HTTP/2 frames and only permits metadata keys present in an allowlist (x-device-id, x-firmware-version, x-device-region, authorization) with value length capped at 128 bytes.

config.cdn: CloudFront distribution with signed URL policy (RSA-SHA1, key pair APKAEIBAERJR2EXAMPLE)
config.origin_restriction: X-Origin-Verify custom header + SG restricted to CloudFront prefix list
config.viewer_request_function: CloudFront Function strips x-admin-*, x-auth-*, x-internal-*, x-source-* headers
config.grpc_web_adapter: ALB-attached adapter with metadata allowlist [x-device-id, x-firmware-version, x-device-region, authorization]
config.signed_url_params: Expires within 300s, IP-restricted to device registered CIDR
config.direct_origin_access: blocked by security group (only CloudFront prefix list allowed)
